text:
morgan: CI red on PR #4312 — failing unit test runtime/serve TestWindowAlign, nondet ordering. Can someone kick a fast rerun + bisect?

jia: saw this. Fails ~3/10 on matrix job 4321, error shows sequence mismatch. Looks like ordering, possibly timer-related.

samir: @morgan drop the job id and any seed you have and I can trigger a targeted rerun on the same matrix axis.

morgan: job id: circleci/4321. Artifact snippet: 
```
--- FAIL: TestWindowAlign (0.12s)
    window_test.go:87: expected [a b c] got [a c b]
```
Seed: RNG_SEED=20260318-7. Locally repros only with `-run TestWindowAlign -count=10 -stress=2`. Different under -race.

noah: quick thought — timer coalescing path does a map iteration when many goroutines signal. PR 4309 touched that area, could be a regression in ordering.

jia: PR 4309 did add a conditional sort in one flush path. Might not cover all codepaths. I can try a small bisect between main@2026-03-16 and the PR commit.

ci-bot: @morgan requested a targeted rerun. To trigger a clean rerun comment "retest this please" on the PR or use `/rerun` in #eng-ci.

morgan: did `/rerun`. Also asking for someone to run a local reproducer on linux/amd64 without -race — behavior diverges for me.

samir: I'll spin up a linux runner tonight and run 20 seeds across the failing axis, and try reproducing with the same env vars. If I get a repro I'll start a git bisect job.

jia: if samir can't repro, we should capture a failing core dump + perf trace when it fails. Adding a debug-only mutex around the timer map iteration would test if iteration ordering is the root cause.

noah: agree. Samir, when you start ping me and I'll quickly push a debug patch that wraps the iteration in a mutex so we can see if the failure rate drops.

morgan: perfect — thanks all. Please post any consistent seed values or failing job links here so I can pin them to a bisect. :thumbsup:

noah: fyi if the debug mutex stabilizes it means ordering was leaking into observable state and we should add a deterministic flush order before reverting.

samir: starting runs in ~30m, will post results and any failing seeds.

morgan: appreciated — will follow up and open a bisect job once we have a failing seed.
